machine_desc: Ryzen 7 5700X desktop, 8 cores / 16 threads, 1 socket, bare metal, Windows 11 Home
wazuh_compared: none in this run file (R6 is a separate run)

method.capacity: median of the unpaced trials: outcomes written after warm-up / time between first and last of them
method.latency: scheduled arrival time (receipt) to the write stage handing the outcome to the sink; a late feeder counts
method.r5_rule: p99 at 0.9 load <= 3 x p99 at 0.5 load
method.allocations: stagelanes_mem::CountingAlloc; per stage after ready, divided by inputs received

command: rulelanes-bench.exe --machine ryzen --machine-desc "Ryzen 7 5700X desktop, 8 cores / 16 threads, 1 socket, bare metal, Windows 11 Home" --date 2026-11-23 --priority time-critical --repeats 2 --loads 0.5,0.6,0.7,0.8,0.9 --note "Load sweep to find where p99 leaves the 50% level. Machine not quiet: another agent building and testing in ../flowlanes (no load benchmarks), a flow collector listening on UDP 2055, Docker Desktop running the rulelanes-oracle-manager container (idle again after the analysisd runs) and Evan's live single-node Wazuh stack (receiving UniFi syslog). Stages spin when idle. Windows cannot isolate a core; tail figures are provisional."
